name: jeffreys_divergence_classical
divergence_log: Classical Jeffreys divergence J(p,q) = KL(p||q)+KL(q||p) is symmetric on a commuting sample space. Quantum Jeffreys J(rho,sigma) = tr((rho-sigma)(log rho - log sigma)) requires operator logarithms whose difference is noncommuting; the classical substrate cannot represent the antisymmetric commutator term that drives nonclassical parameter sensitivity.
